      Get ORN

      • Swap for it. Swap SOL or Bitcoin for ORN with other people, directly between your wallets, on the Swap screen. With SOL it takes a few minutes, and you pay from the SOL wallet you already have, such as Phantom.
      • Mine it on a computer. Install Orien Wallet on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer, open this same wallet there with its recovery phrase, and press Mine. Your computer earns a share of each hour's new ORN.
      • Be paid in ORN. Give someone your address and they can send you ORN from their wallet. Payments arrive in seconds.

      Orien Wallet for computers is at orien.network.

        Post an offer

        Link this wallet to offer swaps

        Sell offers come from linked wallets, so buyers can see who they're swapping with. Linking this wallet to your Orien Network profile sends less than 0.001 ORN from it, once.

        Offer your ORN for SOL. When someone takes it, this app locks the ORN for them and runs the swap, as long as it's open.

        Smallest swap: 0.00015 BTC, more when Bitcoin is busy. Fees: the usual Orien fee to lock the ORN (0.1%, at most 1 ORN), and Bitcoin's network fee for taking the Bitcoin, out of what you receive. If a buyer never pays, your ORN come back on their own within 12 hours.

        Smallest swap: 0.01 SOL. Fees: the usual Orien fee to lock the ORN (0.1%, at most 1 ORN); the buyer covers Solana's small fees. A swap takes about a minute. If a buyer never pays, your ORN come back on their own within a few hours.

        You approve the sale once, now. When someone takes your offer, your wallet accepts it within seconds, even with the window closed. Keep Orien Wallet running.
